QuestInfo.name: [Crimsonheart] Guards of the Castle
QuestInfo.0: Riddly is calling you. What's going on?
QuestInfo.1: Ridley suggested you face 150 Elite Scarlet Phoenixes and 150 Elite Azure Ocelots in the Guardsman Crossway.
QuestInfo.2: You took out a mess of guards!

0.0: You might have a hard time leaving the castle. Naricain's curses can be... persnickety.
0.1: You seem plenty tough, so I bet you could handle the guards of the castle. Want to help us restore this castle to its former glory?
0.2: Take out 150 Elite Scarlet Phoenix and Elite Azure Ocelot guardsmen. You'll get extra tough if you do.

yes.0: I want to see how much stronger you get. (Take the leftmost portal to the Guardsman Crossway, a Party Play zone.)

1.0: You did a number on those guards! Well done.

yes.0: Tynerum is a land with a great history, and a tragic past... Spend a little time here, you'll find more than meets the eye.
